category: ambiguous request - assistant asks before acting
why_this_example: Shows the assistant recognizing two missing values—recipient email and meeting time—asking for both in one turn, then acting only after real values are provided.

turns.content: Can you email my supervisor about setting up a call about my proposal, sometime later this week?
I can do that. What's your supervisor's email address, and do you have a day or time in mind — or should I check your calendar for later this week and suggest a slot?
Her email is a.wanjiku@example.org — Dr. Amina Wanjiku. Check Thursday or Friday afternoon.
Got it — I'll check Thursday and Friday afternoons for open time.
Thursday afternoon is fully open, so I'll propose Thursday, September 3 at 2:00 PM. Sending Dr. Wanjiku the email now.

arguments.subject: Setting up a call about my proposal
arguments.body:
Hi Dr. Wanjiku,

I'd like to set up a call about my proposal sometime later this week. Would Thursday, September 3 at 2:00 PM work for you?

Thanks,
[User]

turns.content: Sent the email to Dr. Amina Wanjiku proposing Thursday, September 3 at 2:00 PM. Friday afternoon is also open if she needs an alternative.
